Exterior — Shared pool (keyfob access) — Golf Cart — 4 Bikes — Patio — Patio table and chairs — Backyard — On-site parking for 5 cars (1 in covered spot, 4 in driveway) Main floor: Kitchen, dining area, living room, 1 bedroom, 1 en-suite bathroom, half bathroom Upper floor: 2 bedrooms, 2 en-suite bathrooms, second living room NeighborhoodSanta Rosa Beach is known for its laid-back atmosphere and natural beauty. Spend your days exploring Grayton Beach State Park, strolling through Gulf Place Town Center, or relaxing on the powder-soft sands of the nearby beach. For outdoor enthusiasts, enjoy biking along the 30A trail, paddleboarding on Western Lake, or golfing at the nearby Santa Rosa Golf Club. Fine dining, boutique shopping, and local art galleries are just minutes away. TransitA car is recommended to fully explore the surrounding 30A communities and nearby state parks. The neighborhood is gated, and the community pool is within a short walking distance from the front door. For those looking to explore without a vehicle, bike rentals are a popular way to navigate the scenic paths along 30A.AccessGuests will have access to the entire home, including the private backyard and patio. Shared community amenities include the large Cypress Breeze neighborhood pool, accessible via a keyfob located in the laundry room. Parking is available for up to five vehicles on-site. NotesPlease note that the shared community pool is located a short distance down the road. Guests must use the provided keyfob for entry. Please always check beach flags before entering the ocean
